create_custom_dataset: create a CustomDataset instance for loading local JSON or CSV files for text generation fine-tuning
build_custom_dataset_json: build a CustomDataset registered as 'json' alias to load local JSON datasets for fine-tuning
build_custom_dataset_csv: build a CustomDataset registered as 'csv' alias to load local CSV datasets for fine-tuning
test_custom_dataset_register: test the CustomDataset class registration with name 'custom' and aliases 'json' and 'csv'
review_custom_dataset: review the CustomDataset class that extends TextGenerationDataset for custom local JSON and CSV data sources
